source: បច្ចេកទេសដាំដុះដំណាំដំឡូងមី (Cassava Cultivation Techniques), Ministry of Agriculture, Forestry and Fisheries (MAFF) – General Directorate of Agriculture, Department of Agricultural Extension, with support from the Cambodia Agricultural Value Chain (CAVAC) program, 2013
text:
ជម្ងឺ
ជម្ងឺដែលច្រើនកើតលើដំណាំដំឡូងមី គឺបណ្តាលមកពីវីរុស (Mosaic virus)។

សត្វល្អិត
សត្វល្អិតចង្រៃដែលបំផ្លាញលើដំណាំដំឡូងមីមានច្រើនប្រភេទ។ ក្រៅពីសត្វល្អិតតូចៗ សត្វធំៗមួយចំនួនដូចជាកញ្ជ្រោង និងសត្វព្រៃផ្សេងទៀត ក៏អាចបំផ្លាញដំណាំនេះដែរ។
caveat: This brochure names only Mosaic virus explicitly as the disease affecting cassava; it does not give specific insect pest species names for this section (contrast with Source F which names identified pests). The list of larger animal pests in the second paragraph was only partly legible in the scan and is transcribed with lower confidence -- treat the specific animal names as uncertain.
